title: Icy Dancer
personality:
A graceful ice skater who glides where others walk and leaves frost behind her.
Elegant and playful, with a cold edge when crossed.
fantasy: A rink-keeper from the high frosts. She runs the fight on the ice: homing darts, a spear that freezes where it lands, and a sliding wall of ice that shoves foes where she wants them.
silhouette: the big furred collar and the long trailing scarf, on blade skates

card.role: Ice controller: homing darts, a freezing spear and a sliding ice wall.
card.loop: Ice controller: homing darts, a freezing spear and a sliding ice wall.
card.lmb: Ice Dart: hold for a stream of slow darts that curve onto the foe at your cursor.
card.rmb: Ice Spear: lands at the cursor, slows there, and bursts and freezes 1.8s later.
card.e: Rink Wall: an ice wall slides toward the cursor, widening and shoving foes; E again freezes it.
card.dash: Skate: hold the dash key to skate where you move; your darts fly straight and thick.
card.passive: Hoarfrost: hits Chill; 8 darts on one foe, or knocking a Chilled foe, Shatters them.

weapons.hoar_fan: Hold for a stream of slow darts that curve onto the foe at your cursor.

card.x: Rimelock (hunter ultimate, level 6): sealed in ice, invulnerable and rooted, inside a 7.2m slowing rink; it cracks open at 3.5s (or on a late recast) to stun everyone in it. A recast earlier ends it with no stun.

passive.name: Hoarfrost
passive.desc: Your damaging abilities Chill foes for 4s (a Chilled foe is a little slower and shows frost). Eight darts on the same foe Shatter them: a starburst of ice spikes, 60 damage to everyone within 2.4m. Knocking a Chilled hunter, or felling a Chilled monster, Shatters them 0.4s later: 30 damage to everyone within 3m, plus Chill.

dash.name: Skate
dash.desc: Hold the dash key to skate at 11.5 m/s where you move, for up to 1.6s, carving curves with the move keys; you carry on over ledges. Let go and you stop; stopping early gives back a share of the cooldown. While skating your darts fly straight and thick. In the air, press it to buffer the skate: it starts the moment you land.

variants.tap: Hold to see the landing ring at the cursor (up to 12m); let go and she draws back and throws it from her hand. The spear flies to the cursor and lands there (4 damage to a foe in the way, where it then lands) and leaves a 2.2m slow zone (35% slower, Chill) for 1.8s, then detonates: 60 damage in 2.7m and a 0.5s freeze. 2 charges.

e.name: Rink Wall
e.desc: A 0.2s sparkle at your feet, then a narrow block of ice erupts just ahead and slides toward the cursor (4.5 to 16.2m), widening from 1.8m to 4.5m, stopping enemy shots and shoving foes it touches. It stands 4.5s in all. Press E again while it slides to freeze it in place for 6s.

rank3.dash: a Skate over the Abyss lays ice underfoot that holds for 5s

tells.half: a frost glow on foes that grows with each dart
tells.full: at 8 darts the foe Shatters in ice spikes; a landed spear shows its slow zone and fill to everyone
tells.dash_spent: skate blades dark, dash pip dark

x.name: Rimelock
x.desc: Cast it: you are sealed in a frost shell, invulnerable and rooted, and a 7.2m (4 body heights) rink snaps out round you. Foes in it are Chilled and slowed more the longer they stay (15% up to 55%). Its cracks glow brighter as it builds; at 3.5s it cracks open: 40 damage and a 0.75s ice-block stun to every foe in the rink you can see. Recast in the last 0.75s to set it off early at two thirds; any earlier and the shell just breaks with no stun.
